from itertools import product

def parse(payload, chunks):

 for chunk in chunks:

B=b'B';
def check(body,chunks,want):
 d=MultipartDecoder(B); out=b'';ev=[];pos=0
 for n in chunks:
  d.receive_data(body[pos:pos+n]);pos+=n
  while 1:
   e=d.next_event()
   if type(e).__name__=='NeedData': break
   ev.append(e)
   if isinstance(e,Data):out+=e.data
 d.receive_data(None)
 while 1:
  e=d.next_event()
  if type(e).__name__=='NeedData': break
  ev.append(e)
  if isinstance(e,Data):out+=e.data
  if type(e).__name__=='Epilogue': break
 assert out==want,(len(out),len(want),ev)
for payload in [b'',b'a\r\nb\r\r\n']:
 body=b'--B\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="f"; filename="x"\r\n\r\n'+payload+b'\r\n--B--\r\n'

 # splits after boundary itself, after first closing hyphen, and around CRLF
 cuts=[body.index(b'--B--')+4,body.index(b'--B--')+5]
